extracted.name: Cricket Protein Powder Brownies
extracted.description: Brownies that prove eco-friendly eating can taste amazing. The deep cocoa and chocolate flavors perfectly complement the cricket protein powder, creating a high-protein dessert that tastes exactly like a traditional bakery favorite.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a small loaf pan or 6"x6" pan with greased parchment paper.
Whisk warm butter and sugar, then add egg, water, and vanilla.
Stir in combined dry ingredients and fold in chips.
